The '''Barundi''' were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the planet [[Barundi]] and encountered on an unnamed planet in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. A primitive society, the Barundi fashioned their lives around the promotion of perpetual happiness. The Barundi found in Wild Space worshiped the [[Yavin Vassilika]] as a god.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Barundi01.jpg|thumb|left|185px|The Barundi.]]
The Barundi were blue-skinned humanoids with thick plugs of tightly-braided hair on their high-domed heads. There was no apparent dimorphism between [[Gender/Legends|males]] and females. The Barundi displayed broad, toothed smiles with prominent canines. Coarse body hair covered the forearms and chests of adult Barundi.

==Culture and history==
{{Quote|Certainly are friendly...|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="U:TYV4">[[Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika 4|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'' 4]]</ref>}}
The Barundi society was built upon maintaining harmony and happiness. Any deviation from the strict doctrines and the offender was sentenced to immediate capital punishment. Accosting their [[Yavin Vassilika|idol]] was grounds for a ritualized "cleansing of the soul."<ref name="U:TYV4" /> The Barundi believed that when a person strays from peace without reason, that they are in need of "assisted reincarnation." The Barundi then publicly beat the offender(s) to death with large flowers. The true cause of death, however, is most likely from the poisonous thorns in the petals.<ref name="U:TYV4" />

The Barundi encountered by [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], [[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika|et al]], were supposedly deposited on the unnamed planet several millennia ago.<ref name="U:TYV4" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, Barundi is the name an ethnic group in the East African country of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burundi Burundi], and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barundi,_Punjab a village] in the state of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punjab,_India Punjab] in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India India].
